purpose: Restore and test the evolved GIADA data methodology before any further paper-scale generation.
supersedes: S1b only as the candidate primary data methodology; S1 and S1b remain immutable stochastic controls.

design.causal_pairing: All targeted arms in a family share equilibrium state, Random123 seed, duration and pre-intervention history. Stochastic backgrounds are separate controls.

background_controls: active-support NeuronIO; separate seeded controls, not a same-history counterfactual pair

hard_gates: no seed crosses train and validation
every causal family is complete within each pair_id
every arm in a pair has the same seed and split
all seven anatomical probes use stable segment ids
every transition has 41 voltage samples including 1 ms boundaries
protocol outcome summaries are reported separately by split
decision_rule: Use the audit to choose a prospective hybrid corpus composition; do not train on S1c and do not call it a held-out test.
